mapper.sql: n.id, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.publisher_id, n.publish_time, n.view_count, n.status, n.created_by, n.creation_date, n.modify_by, n.modify_date
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name AS publisher_name FROM notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.id WHERE n.status = 1 ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT , u.real_name AS publisher_name FROM notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.id ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC
SELECT , u.real_name AS publisher_name FROM notice n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON n.publisher_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, type, publisher_id, publish_time, view_count, status, created_by, creation_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{publisherId}, NOW(), 0, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
